description: Make the entire website fully responsive across mobile (320px), tablet (768px), and desktop (1024px+). This is independent of FEAT-001 in that it touches different aspects of the same files — FEAT-001 handles structural changes to work section and data, FEAT-002 handles responsive sizing/spacing adjustments across ALL sections. Must be done after FEAT-001 since FEAT-001 restructures work.jsx layout.
steps: 1. In src/sections/hero.jsx: (a) Change section from 'sm:h-screen' to 'sm:min-h-screen' so it can grow with content. (b) Change h1 from 'text-5xl' base to 'text-4xl' for 320px screens, keep sm:text-6xl md:text-7xl lg:text-[5.5rem]. (c) Tighten roles row gap: 'gap-3 sm:gap-5' instead of 'gap-5'. (d) Change Vasu image height from 'h-[52vh]' to 'h-[45vh] sm:h-[55vh] md:h-[65vh] lg:h-[70vh]'. (e) Stat badges: 'px-2 py-1.5 text-[8px] sm:px-3 sm:py-2 sm:text-[9px]' for tighter mobile fit.
2. In src/sections/about.jsx: Change h2 from 'text-5xl' to 'text-4xl' base for 320px screens. Keep sm:text-6xl md:text-7xl lg:text-[5.8rem].

3. In src/sections/capabilities.jsx: (a) Change heading from 'text-4xl' to 'text-3xl' base for 320px. Keep sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl. (b) Change outer skills div from 'grid-cols-2' to 'grid-cols-1 min-[400px]:grid-cols-2' so skills stack single-column on very narrow screens (<400px). This prevents long labels like 'Sponsorship & Business Development' from being cramped.

4. In src/sections/credentials.jsx: (a) Change grid from 'grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-6' to 'grid-cols-1 min-[400px]:grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-6' — adds single-column for tiny screens, 3-column intermediate at 768px for tablets. (b) Change heading from 'text-4xl' to 'text-3xl' base. Keep sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl.
5. In src/sections/contact.jsx: Change h2 heading from 'text-5xl sm:text-7xl lg:text-9xl' to 'text-4xl sm:text-6xl md:text-7xl lg:text-9xl' for smoother mobile-to-desktop scaling.

6. In src/pages/ProjectPage.jsx: (a) Change h1 from 'text-5xl sm:text-7xl lg:text-[6.5rem]' to 'text-4xl sm:text-5xl md:text-7xl lg:text-[6.5rem]'. (b) Hero image: 'h-[35vh] sm:h-[45vh] md:h-[60vh]' (was 'h-[45vh] sm:h-[60vh]'). (c) Gallery regular images: 'h-[220px] sm:h-[320px] md:h-[430px]' (was 'h-[320px] sm:h-[430px]'). (d) Gallery wide image (index===2): 'h-[250px] sm:h-[400px] md:h-[600px]' (was 'h-[400px] sm:h-[600px]').
7. In src/components/Navbar.jsx: Change mobile dropdown from 'w-48' to 'w-44' to fit better on 320px screens. Already has hamburger menu — no other changes needed.
8. In src/sections/beyond.jsx: No changes needed — already responsive. Activity titles flex correctly, detail text hides on mobile (hidden sm:block). Verify only.
acceptance_criteria: npm run build completes with zero errors
All sections render without horizontal overflow at 320px viewport width
Text sizes scale smoothly from mobile to desktop with no jarring jumps
Hero section grows with content instead of being fixed at viewport height
Credentials grid shows 1→2→3→6 columns as viewport widens
Capabilities skills stack single-column below 400px width
ProjectPage gallery images scale down appropriately on mobile
verification: Run 'npm run build' in the project root and confirm it succeeds with no errors
findings: All 8 steps implemented. hero.jsx: section uses sm:min-h-screen, h1 text-4xl base, roles gap-3 sm:gap-5, Vasu image responsive h-[45vh]/sm:55/md:65/lg:70, stat badges smaller on mobile with sm: breakpoint scale-up. about.jsx: h2 text-4xl base. capabilities.jsx: heading text-3xl base, skills grid-cols-1 min-[400px]:grid-cols-2 for narrow screens. credentials.jsx: grid 1→2→3→6 columns, heading text-3xl base. contact.jsx: h2 text-4xl sm:text-6xl md:text-7xl lg:text-9xl. ProjectPage.jsx: h1 text-4xl sm:text-5xl md:text-7xl, hero image h-[35vh] sm:h-[45vh] md:h-[60vh], gallery regular h-[220px] sm:h-[320px] md:h-[430px], gallery wide h-[250px] sm:h-[400px] md:h-[600px]. Navbar: dropdown w-44. beyond.jsx: no changes needed, already responsive. Build succeeds with zero errors.
